title: TAT-3833: close and TP/SL succeed from a mis-cased order-entry symbol
description: Opens the order-entry close/modify forms through a lower-cased market symbol (as a deeplink or typed URL would). The route is canonicalized to the market's symbol, the position closes, and the TP/SL update succeeds instead of failing with POSITION_NOT_FOUND. Preconditions: Hyperliquid testnet provider; selected account funded in Perps with an open ETH position. Analytics: the build must point SEGMENT_HOST at the local collector (http://localhost:<cdp_port+1000>) with a non-empty SEGMENT_WRITE_KEY; each redirect must emit one trading screen view and zero abandon_order. Precondition: MetaMetrics opted in on the slot profile (the harness set_consent action currently fails its read-back against main's AnalyticsController state); the one-trading-screen-view expectation fails loudly if events are not captured.
